advancements.principiamagica.the_clay_re: Something was pressed into this clay long ago. You should write it down.
book.principiamagica.principia.name: Principia
book.principiamagica.principia.the_wet_c: The clay by the river bears marks: wedges, rows of them, too regular to be chance. I have started copying them here. If they are words, someone meant them to last.
*In the beginning the gods laboured, and the labour was heavy. They dug the rivers. They bore the baskets. And they wept beneath the weight.*
book.principiamagica.principia.tooltip:
A notebook of copied tablets.
§o(In-Game Guide for Principia Magica)§r

job_option.principiamagica.bonemeal.desc: Use bone meal on crops that can still grow. Bone meal is restocked from supply containers.
job_option.principiamagica.bonemeal_sapl: Use bone meal on saplings in the work area so trees grow faster. Bone meal is restocked from supply containers.
Break natural leaves around a trunk when they stop the golem from reaching it. Player-placed leaves are never broken.
job_option.principiamagica.clear_obstruc: Clear grass, flowers and similar plants from the work area so crops can be planted. Seeds dropped by grass go into the golem's inventory.
Pick up loose items inside the work zone and deposit them.
job_option.principiamagica.replant.descr: Plant a seed on empty farmland after harvesting, preferring the seed that grew there before.
job_option.principiamagica.replant_sapli: Plant a matching sapling on the stump of each felled tree. Saplings are restocked from supply containers.
job_option.principiamagica.till.descript: Turn dirt and grass near water into farmland. Needs a hoe in the main hand and uses its durability.
